subject: general
question: The resources in the Web are identified with the help of which among the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uniform Resource Locator**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uniform Resource Locator (URL) **is the address used to access resources on the Web.
 
• A URL specifies the location of a resource and the protocol used to access it, such as HTTP or HTTPS.
 
• URLs are essential for navigating the Internet and identifying web pages, images, videos, and other resources.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Web Resource Locator** - This term is incorrect. The correct term is Uniform Resource Locator (URL).
 
• **Resource Finder** - This is not a standard term used for identifying resources on the web.
 
• **Hypertext Resources** - While hypertext is a key concept in web technologies, this term is not used to identify web resources.
